name: EQ
questions: I easily recognize other people's emotions from their face and voice
I understand why I have certain emotions
I can control my emotions in stressful situations
I know how to calm another person down when they feel bad
I notice changes in the mood of people around me
I can accurately put into words what I feel
My emotions don't get in the way of making important decisions
